verdict.label: jaywalking
verdict.reasoning:
The event is real. The main-road head shows red for the whole window (247-274 s). I measured the man in black (black shirt and trousers, shoulder-bag strap; track 3582) against the painted cw2 stripes rather than the layout polygon, at about 8-10 px per metre (cw2 is about 33 px deep, roughly 4 m).

Path of the man in black:
- 242-246 s: walks along cw1's upper edge to the median tip, then steps onto cw2 at about 246.5-247.
- 247.5-248.5: at the upper ends of the cw2 stripes, or up to about 1 m beyond them.
- 249.25: both feet about 10-15 px beyond the stripe ends.
- 250.0: about 16-21 px beyond (about 2 m), in the first outbound lane. The crowd walking the other way is on the stripes.
- 251.25: about 21 px beyond. 252.0: about 26 px. 252.25: about 30 px, and still moving away.
- The black sedan passes about 3-4 m beyond him at 250.5-251.25. That is not a near miss.

There is no sharp "veer" at 251.75. He walks one steady diagonal from the median tip, so the gap from cw2 just keeps growing. By 251.25 he is already about 2.5 m outside the paint, so the first-pass start is about 2 s late.

I put the start at 250.0, the first sampled frame where both feet are clearly (about 2 m) off the paint. A strict "left the paint" reading would give about 248.5-249.25, so a start anywhere from 248.5 to 250.0 is defensible.

From about 253 s he turns up toward the far side. His feet are at roughly (1416,458) at 254, (1444,444) at 257, (1420,421) at 259, (1327,393) at 262, (1266,348) at 267 and (1223,329) at 270. After about 260 he walks up-left in the gutter along the grass-strip wall.

End: at 270.75 his feet are about 9 px below the kerb, on the road. At 271.0-271.25 both feet reach the kerb line at about (1214,311), next to the bus-stop group. At 271.5 he is on the sidewalk. So the end is about 271.2.

Other jaywalkers inside the window (these merge into the same segment):
- Several of the crowd cut diagonally off cw2 toward the right sidewalk at 253-256, including the young person in a white shirt with a black backpack who walked beside him.
- (a) Tan-shirt man with backpack: at 260 he is about 75 px below cw1. He passes island_tri1's right tip at about 265 and reaches cw3 at about 266.5. Confirmed.
- (b) Older man in white shirt with phone: at 266 he is about 60 px below cw1 in the slip lane above island_tri1's left tip, and on cw3 by about 268.5. Confirmed.
- (c) Man with red shoes: crosses asphalt from cw1 to island_tri1 at about 263-265.5, then from island_tri1 to island_3 starting about 268.0. He steps onto island_3 at about 270.5, not 269.3. Either way this ends before 271.2.

Possible extension of the end:
- A young man in a white long-sleeve shirt and black trousers, phone at his ear, leaves cw1's lower edge at about x=880.
- He is 0.5-1 m off the paint at 271.25-272.0 and 2-3 m off by 272.5-273.
- He crosses the junction diagonally and steps onto island_tri1's apex at about 275.5. From about 277.75 to 279 he crosses asphalt again, from island_tri1 to cw3.
- Using the same roughly 2 m rule as my start, his jaywalking begins at about 272.3. That leaves a gap of about 1 s after 271.2, so I treat it as a separate segment.
- Under a strict edge-of-paint rule it would touch this segment, and the merged end would be about 275.5.

Rejected:
- The two women standing all through the window at island_3's left tip, at the end of the cw3 stripes, are standing on an island or crossing, so not jaywalking.
- The e-scooter riders on cw1 and cw2 count as vehicles.
- The white-shirt youth at 244-247 walks within about 0.5-1 m of cw1's upper edge. That is borderline, and I did not count it.

first.label: jaywalking
first.where: lower carriageway (cross-street lane under island_3), x~810-1120, y~935-1080, 1.5-3 m right of cw3
first.description: Main road green. The man in black with red shoes (track 4490) has been standing on island_3 since ~270.3. He steps off its bottom edge at ~280.75 and walks diagonally down-right across the asphalt, 100-250 px right of the cw3 stripes. He leaves the frame at the bottom edge at ~285.25; the end is set at frame exit because his arrival at the kerb is not visible.

verdict.label: jaywalking
verdict.reasoning:
I don't think this is a jaywalking event. It looks like the normal way this crowd crosses at cw3: people walk alongside the zebra, a little off the stripes. The first-pass description of his path is accurate. My disagreement is only about whether it counts as the class.

What I saw:
- Signal: main road red+yellow at 276.8, green from about 277.3. The group waiting at island_3 and the right edge of cw3 then crosses the lower half of cw3, which is the normal pedestrian phase for cw3.
- 266-272: the man in black with red shoes walks down from the island_tri1 area and reaches island_3. He stands on its lower-right part from about 272 to 280.2.
- Stepping off: at 280.0-280.2 his feet are on the bottom kerb of island_3. At 280.4 his red shoe is below the kerb on the asphalt, so he steps off at about 280.3 (not 280.75).
- His path: he walks down and to the right, drifting away from the stripes. His feet were at about x=836,y=957 at 281.0 (roughly 1 m right of the stripe ends), x=944,y=1050 at 283.0 (about 150-160 px, roughly 1.8 m, right of the stripes), and x~1000 at 284.0 (about 170 px). At 283.8-284.0 his feet leave the bottom edge of the frame. His head is still visible at x~1160 at 285.8 and is gone by 286.2. The kerb he walks to is never visible.
- He is not alone: the woman in black, the woman in white and the man in the tan shirt walking with him are also off the stripes on the right side, by about 0.5-1.5 m (for example, the woman in black is about 145 px right at 285.0). He is just the one furthest out in the group.
- The same thing happens in earlier cycles in the same spot. At 203-207 a man in black walks at about x=836,y~1040, right of the stripes. At 129-137 several pedestrians in white walk at about x=880-916, right of the stripes, in both directions. So people walking in this strip right of cw3 is routine at every cw3 phase, not a separate incident.
- No vehicle is involved. The grey SUV and the taxi pass well to the right and above him (x~1100-1400, y~750-850), and nobody brakes or swerves.

Taken literally, the brief's definition ("on the carriageway outside a crossing") is met, since he is 1-3 m outside the stripes. But he is walking with a group that is crossing legally, at the zebra, on its own phase, and drifting beside it rather than crossing somewhere else. If this counted, most cycles would contain a jaywalking event, and I doubt the ground truth labels that. Precision matters more than recall here and the fit to the class is unclear, so I reject it.

If the team decides to count it anyway, the times would be start about 280.3 (he steps off the island_3 kerb) and end about 286.0 (he is fully out of frame; his feet already leave the frame at about 284.0). The same segment would then have to include the companions walking off the stripes.

first.label: failure_to_yield
first.where: cw3, upper (junction-side) part near the gantry corner, x~100-460, y~700-900
first.description: Main road green, cw3 pedestrian phase. A black BMW X5 turns right from the kerb lane into the lower-left side street. It creeps through cw3 (front on the zebra ~285.0) while a young man in a dark suit and a woman in a white shirt walk down the crossing. At 285.5-286.0 its front-left corner is within ~0.5 m of the man. The BMW's rear clears the crossing ~288.0. The black BYD SUV behind it enters cw3 at ~287.75, 20-50 px behind the same couple, and turns through (288.0-288.5) while other pedestrians are still on the zebra. It leaves ~290.2. The two vehicles went through the same group back to back, so they are merged into one segment, like the accepted 52.6 s case.

verdict.label: failure_to_yield
verdict.reasoning:
Checked with a 0.5 s sheet over 281-294.2, then zoomed crops at 0.25, 0.2 and 0.1 s steps of the upper, junction-side end of cw3 (roughly x 0-600, y 620-1000). The main-road head shows green the whole time, so it is the cw3 pedestrian phase and a large group is walking down the zebra.

(1) BMW X5, black, plate ..G171GB. It is queued at the corner from about 283.5 and creeps forward as a young man in a dark suit and a woman in a white shirt step onto the top of cw3 from the gantry-corner sidewalk. At 284.6-284.8 its bumper is at the top edge of the painted bars. By 284.9-285.0 its front-left corner is over the right-hand ends of the top bars, right at the woman's side. From 285.2 to 286.0 its front-left headlight is within about 0.5 m of the couple while they are on the zebra, and it keeps rolling. It turns left-down behind them, across the upper part of the crossing. Its rear passes the left-hand ends of the bars at about 288.0-288.2.

(2) BYD SUV, black. It follows straight behind and its front reaches the right-hand ends of the bars at about 287.8-288.0, before the BMW has fully cleared. It passes 20-50 px behind the same couple, and other pedestrians (a man in a white T-shirt, a youth with a backpack, and more) are still on the zebra next to it from 288.2 to 289.8. At 0.1 s steps its rear clears the left-hand ends of the bars at about 290.3-290.4.

Neither vehicle stops or waits for the people on the crossing. This matches the class definition: a vehicle drives through a crossing while pedestrians are on it.

Merging: the two passes overlap in time (BYD enters at about 287.9, BMW leaves at about 288.1). Under the brief's rule for simultaneous same-class events they form one segment, from the BMW entering (285.0) to the BYD leaving (about 290.4). The first-pass end of 290.2 is slightly early; its start of 285.0 is right.

Rejected as not part of this event: the grey SUV behind the BYD (front at the corner from about 290.25) stops and waits for the pedestrians through at least 292.25. That is yielding, and it is not continuous with this segment.

The camera zooms and pans a little during the clip, but the zebra ends were judged in each frame, so this does not affect the timing.

first.label: illegal_turn
first.where: approach lane 2 from the kerb (stop-line position x~340, y~510), then into the slip lane between the corner and island_tri1 and the lower-left side street

verdict.label: illegal_turn
verdict.reasoning:
Real event. Black BYD SUV (plate UA777SS, track 4421) makes a right turn from lane 2 (second lane from the kerb) into the slip lane and the lower-left side street. Nothing in the painted markings allows that lane to turn right.

Lane geometry (from work/bg/C3902.png and the empty frames at 160 s and 240 s; no vehicles and no lane arrows or lane-direction markings anywhere on the visible approach):
- Stop line runs from about (236,568) to (700,508).
- Kerb lane: from the kerb (about x=236 at the stop line) to lane line a, which runs from about (100,396) to (368,548).
- Lane 2: from line a to line b, which runs from about (228,384) to (500,530).
